Hardware + Tools Germany 2025

Presented our full product range including new cordless tool kits and industrial-grade equipment.

Event Overview

Hardware + Tools Germany stands as Europe's premier trade fair for hardware, tools, and DIY supplies, drawing thousands of industry professionals from across the continent and beyond. Held annually in Cologne, the exhibition serves as a critical meeting point for manufacturers, distributors, and buyers seeking the latest innovations in hand tools, power tools, fastening systems, and workshop equipment. The event's reputation for quality and scale makes it an indispensable fixture on the global sourcing calendar.

This year marked HOLGENVY's debut at Hardware + Tools Germany, representing a strategic milestone in our expansion into the European market. Our team showcased a comprehensive selection of professional-grade power tools and cordless solutions, engaging directly with distributors, retailers, and procurement specialists from over 20 countries. The European market has long been a benchmark for quality and innovation in the tool industry, and our participation underscored our commitment to meeting the exacting standards that this market demands.

Highlights

  • 5-day exhibition with continuous live product demonstrations at our booth
  • Demonstrated 30+ product SKUs across cordless, brushless, and industrial categories
  • 150+ visitor interactions including distributors, retailers, and procurement managers
  • Signed 3 distribution letters of intent with partners in Germany, France, and the Netherlands
  • Overwhelmingly positive reception of our cordless platform system and its cross-compatibility

Products Showcased

  • Cordless Tool Kit — Complete multi-tool solution featuring drill driver, impact driver, and reciprocating saw with shared battery platform
  • Brushless Drill Series — High-torque brushless motor drills designed for continuous professional use with extended runtime
  • Industrial Angle Grinder — Heavy-duty 125mm angle grinder built for demanding metalworking and masonry applications
  • Demolition Hammer — SDS-Max demolition hammer delivering consistent impact energy for concrete and stone removal
  • Battery Platform System — Interchangeable lithium-ion battery ecosystem powering all HOLGENVY cordless tools for maximum flexibility

European Market Insights

Our time at the exhibition provided valuable insights into the European market landscape. EU regulatory requirements, particularly CE certification, remain a non-negotiable entry barrier that demands rigorous compliance from all manufacturers. European customers consistently expressed a strong preference for cordless solutions, driven by jobsite safety regulations and the convenience of wireless operation across multiple tools. The competitive landscape is intense, with established European brands maintaining strong brand loyalty, but we observed a growing openness among distributors to source from manufacturers who can deliver reliable quality at competitive price points — particularly when backed by a unified battery platform that reduces total cost of ownership for end users.

Next Steps

Following the success of our debut, we have scheduled follow-up meetings with all three distribution partners who signed letters of intent, with the goal of finalizing territory agreements by Q2 2025. Additionally, we are evaluating participation in future European exhibitions, including BAU Munich and Fastener Fair Stuttgart, to further strengthen our presence in the region. Our product development team is also incorporating feedback received at the show to refine our cordless platform for the specific needs of European professional users.
